title: Q-SPEC-25-platform-usage-reader: read Durable Object usage from the platform's analytics and run the TS-10 cross-check on a clock
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** specification audit 2026-11-26: the row is PLANNED in the status table of specs/US-SPEC-25-tenant-storage.md
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "crossCheck" -- workers/adapters/cloudflare/src
**Status:** closed

`crossCheck` in `workers/core/tenantstore/spend.js` compares a tenant's self-metered reads, writes and requests with a platform reading and reports a divergence over 20 percent as a finding and a missing field as unmeasured. Nothing produces the platform reading yet. Add an adapter under `workers/adapters/cloudflare/src/` that reads the account's Durable Object analytics for the tenant Worker (the dataset and field names must be read from Cloudflare's GraphQL schema, not assumed; `seed/worker/src/spend.js` shows the D1 and Workers query the tick already runs), map it to `{ reads, writes, requests }`, call `crossCheck` from the scheduled handler, and file one item per finding with the next reading as its closing probe. An unreadable analytics answer is unmeasured, never ok. Bind a Vectorize index for the first tenant that nears `maxVectors` in the same lane (TS-9 is built against a fake only).

**Closing probe:** `node --test --no-warnings workers/core/tenantstore/tenantstore.test.js`
**Prediction:** spec25_planned_rows <= 0 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** raising any tenant's budget; treating an unreadable platform reading as agreement; changing the deployed copy under tenants/ by hand without the same change in workers/core/tenantstore.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
